facts.text: Riggins takes its name from John Riggins, the area’s first mailman, whose post helped shape the town’s early ranching, mining, and lumber heritage.
A historic boat now sits atop City Park, one of 21 markers that guide visitors through Riggins’ walking tour of local landmarks.
Riggins is the most northwestern town in the Mountain Time Zone, with Pacific Time beginning just north across the Salmon River.
Every early May, the Riggins Rodeo draws crowds to the arena, where riders compete on grandstands or from a hillside overlook.
The annual Hot Summer Nights festival, a two‑day music and talent show, lights up Riggins each July with local performers.
